assumptions.statement: The submitted Overall Design Area and three key-area polygons are rough provisional constraints, not official boundaries or precise location bases.
assumptions.impact: All absolute areas, ratios, land-use partitions, key-area diagrams, and phased geometries must be recalculated when official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: The twelve lived-friction work orders are hypotheses until the two site walks and anonymous interviews are completed and cleared by the user.
assumptions.impact: The final proposal may say only that a friction was observed when it links to a field record; unverified work orders remain proposed tests, not resident needs.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, Building Height, Building Coverage Ratio, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, existing-building status, municipal utilities, fire safety, flood control, heritage constraints, and operating parties are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: These controls remain unknown; the proposal gives qualitative strategies and professional-development prerequisites only.

assumptions.statement: The Lived Friction Open Day, Useful Failure Night, Jing-Zhang Calibration Week, AI Register, and three Honor Nodes are conceptual operating proposals.
assumptions.impact: Frequency, organizer, funding, permits, safety, and long-term maintenance require public-sector and professional confirmation; no government commitment is claimed.

assumptions.statement: All AI and embodied-AI tests require a responsible operator, lawful data, insurance where applicable, emergency plans, Human Review, offline alternatives, and explicit stop conditions.
assumptions.impact: The design package is not authorization to deploy, collect data, or conduct public trials.
